sections.title: Emergency Procedures
items: Correct type of fire extinguishers ready to be placed onsite

sections.title: Carparking
items: Are there any restrictions regarding carparking?

sections.title: Fire Risk Control
items: Fire extinguishers ordered for all levels and areas
Correct type of fire extinguishers placed in the vicinity of hazardous martials storage area and sign posted
Smoking area have sand boxes and fire extinguisher
Lunch/office areas to have fire extinguishers
Portable halogen lamps to be 1 meter off ground and away from flammable materials, doors etc.

sections.title: Utilities
items: If not, are alternatives in place?

sections.title: Water Damage Control
items: Bunding around doorways and stair access
Temporary water supply to have lockable master shut off valve and shut off at the end of each day

sections.title: Asbestos Management
items: Is there the requirement for an Asbestos Survey?
If yes, has survey been undertaken?
Is there an asbestos management plan in place?
Has the management plan been submitted/provided?
Is appropriate PPE available, fit tested (respiratory) and used correctly
Where asbestos has been managed by third party, have Clearance certificates been issued

sections.title: Site Documentation
items: Site H&S folder ready to be issued
